_comment: Route Usability Gate, course-type extension (MIXED / OUT_AND_BACK / POINT_TO_POINT). Pre-registered and frozen before the first non-LOOP pool (IMPL1_PLAN P0 / P6). Values from USABILITY_GATE_DESIGN.md v2.1 section 13 (sha256 984ccc140de19a9f525f61dc1cb769cd86eed12df8d2e9a26c78bcd02eb61252), the shared shape definitions of local-network COURSE_SHAPE_DESIGN_v2.md (sha256 9dc86d45...) and user decision 3. No value was tuned on outcome data.
_revision: draft1 (ug-v2.draft1.json, sha256 af6e7cf5...) -> draft2 (ug-v2.draft2.json, sha256 97d29b77...): N1 d_min graph (app-maximum midpoint disk), N2 PE5 polygon / line / bridge semantics + known false negative -> draft3 (ug-v2.draft3.json, sha256 f759e849...): N2 clarifications (endpoint-touch exemption, bridge-incident end node, shared pe5_blocked function) and the structural / tag-based FAIL split -> draft4a (ug-v2.draft4a.json, sha256 bbee35e8..., superseded the same hour) -> this file (rev4): PE5 per env-terrain ruling ei1_rev3_ruling.md (accepted by lead): polygon pass-through, per-polygon bridge exemption (P covered), no exemption for env lines, independence note, accepted residual. No new number.

fail_code_classes.routing: tag_based FAIL hits go to the review_queue (gate_level FAIL, action candidate_removed); structural FAILs must stay at 0 and go to a separate incidents log

loop.rules: identical to ug-v1 (LOOP column). Every type extension must re-pass the LOOP regression: GateResult and TOP3 of LOOP requests unchanged.
loop._basis: design v2.1 section 13-2 'LOOP regression'; IMPL1_PLAN principle 4

shape_definitions.out_and_back_ratio: sum over edges traversed in BOTH directions of (length x times) / route length (runway_route_features.py:118)
shape_definitions.stem: connected component (shared nodes) of the edges traversed in both directions; stem_length = unique length of its edges; start stem contains the start node, spur = any other stem
shape_definitions.gate_keys_on: REQUEST type; the RESULT shape is an observation
shape_definitions._basis: classify_shape thresholds 0.15 / 0.60 (runway_route_features.py:26-27, :70-71); shared with local-network COURSE_SHAPE_DESIGN_v2 section 1

MIXED._comment: not offered by the user decisions; values frozen for completeness

type_matrix._comment: rules not listed per type are identical to ug-v1: F1, F2, F4, F7, R1-R5 (incl. Design B levels), observations, confidence, parallel-way attribution, Stage B (F1-F4), gate_version

F3._basis: shape definitions above; P2P end = snap(destination) (local-network design)

POINT_TO_POINT.d_min: shortest RUNNABLE network distance snap(start) -> snap(destination), computed on the app-maximum midpoint disk (see d_min_graph)

d_min_graph.radius_m: 1.1 * 21.1 km / 2 + 250 m = 11855 m, independent of T
d_min_graph._basis: N1 (env-terrain E-I1, accepted by lead): a T-sized disk cannot contain the infeasible shortest path (> 1.1 T); every d_min <= 23.21 km (= 1.1 x 21.1 km) lies inside the 11.855 km disk. Existing constants only: MAX_KM 21.1, tolerance 1.1, WORK_BUFFER_M 250

F5._basis: TOLERANCE 0.10 (code constant); P2P = user decision 3 (IMPL1_PLAN); 21.1 km / 1 km = MAX_KM / MIN_KM (user decision 2026-11-09, S15P31E105-607); 0.5 km = runway.html:35 input step

MIXED._basis: 0.15 / 0.60 = classify_shape class bounds (type definition); repeated cap 0.30 = pre-registered new value, basis: clean-stem identity repeated = oab / 2, so the class upper bound 0.60 / 2. U-turn 0: a stem is re-entered at its junction, never by a -> b -> a

OUT_AND_BACK._basis: oab >= 0.60 = classify_shape OUT_AND_BACK bound, i.e. the pre-registered return-deviation allowance is at most 40 % of the length off the outbound path (new value, basis = class bound); repeated <= 0.50 = definition (every edge at most out and back once; a pure OAB has oab 1.0 / repeated 0.5, not penalised); exactly one immediate U-turn at the turnaround (local-network shape design)

POINT_TO_POINT._basis: LOOP caps (code constants REPEATED_MAX, MAX_OAB_LOOP, quality_ok) per local-network shape design

LOOP_MIXED_OUT_AND_BACK.working_area: disk centred on the start, radius 1.1 * T / 2 + 250 m (runway_busan_graph.working_radius)

POINT_TO_POINT.working_area: disk centred on the start-destination midpoint, radius 1.1 * T / 2 + 250 m; any re-request with a new T rebuilds the disk (P2P A, local-network design)

R6._basis: COVERAGE_EDGE_M 100 (code constant); working areas from local-network COURSE_SHAPE_DESIGN_v2

end_point_rules._comment: PE codes shared with local-network COURSE_SHAPE_DESIGN_v2 section 10; env-terrain EP crosswalk: PE1 = EP6, PE3 covers EP4 dead-end / U-turn and the EP1 tunnel-edge part, PE4 = EP1 + EP5, PE5 = EP2, PE6 = EP3. None applies to the LOOP start (LOOP path unchanged).

PE1._basis: code constant MAX_SNAP_M 250 (same as the start)

PE2.condition: end node in the same RUNNABLE connected component as the start node (generator + Gate)
PE2._basis: definition (a route on the RUNNABLE graph needs one component); snap_start main-component rule

b_end_edge.runnable_tunnel: tunnel present and not in {no, building_passage}

end_edges.OUT_AND_BACK: the two traversals at the turnaround node

PE3._basis: pre-registered value lists (design v2.1 section 13-2, env-terrain EP4); highways = runway_route_features.MAJOR, ROAD_HW = runway_walk_filter.ROAD_HW

PE4.stage: generator snap-time hard rule; Gate re-check on the output

forbidden_incident_edges.road_tunnel: ROAD_HW and tunnel present and not in {no, building_passage}

PE4.adjacency: all-status edges of the request graph (cg.edges_all)
PE4._basis: env-terrain EP1 + EP5 (known_cases: Gwangan Bridge, busways, Suyeong foot=no, Hwangnyeong tunnel are all EXCLUDED/UNCERTAIN); search radius = MAX_SNAP_M

PE5.stage: generator snap-time hard rule; Gate re-check on the output

geometry.notation: P = user destination point, N = snapped end node, S = straight segment P -> N
geometry.blocking_edges: block unless S meets the blocking edge exactly in {P} (the user clicked on that road; exact touch, no tolerance). Any crossing elsewhere along S, a collinear overlap, or a contact at N blocks (N contact is also PE4)
geometry.env_polygons: block iff the interior of S meets the polygon interior (DE-9IM 'T********') AND NOT both P and N are covered by that polygon. Equivalently: far-bank pass-through (both outside, S through the interior) blocks; exactly one inside blocks; both covered by the same polygon (boundary included) does not block; a waterline click (P on the boundary, S pointing landward) does not block
geometry.env_lines: block when S crosses the line (coast / river centre lines); a touch only at P or only at N does not block
geometry.bridge_exemption: per polygon only: a polygon does not block when P is covered by THAT polygon AND N is incident to a RUNNABLE way whose bridge tag is present and != 'no' (decidable at snap time). No bridge exemption for env_lines or blocking_edges. A near-bank or far-bank click (P uncovered) snapped to a bridge end with S through the water still blocks
geometry.shared_function: usability_gate.pe5_blocked(dest_lonlat, node_lonlat, edge_lines, env_polys, env_lines, end_is_bridge) is used by BOTH the generator snap step and the Gate re-check, so they cannot disagree; end_is_bridge = usability_gate.end_node_on_bridge(ctx, N)
geometry._basis: N2 (env-terrain E-I1, accepted by lead): plain 'intersects' would reject destinations on bridges and waterline beach clicks. rev3 clarifications (local-network). rev4 = env-terrain ruling ei1_rev3_ruling.md items 1-4 (accepted by lead): polygon pass-through, exact {P} touch for blocking edges, endpoint-touch for env lines, per-polygon bridge exemption with P covered; polygon formula as proposed by local-network (satisfies the far-bank, one-inside, both-inside, same-bank and waterline cases). No number added.

PE5.independence_note: the snap step and the Gate share pe5_blocked, so the Gate re-check cannot catch a bug inside it (common cause); PE5 independence rests on QA: the P6 positive controls (far bank, pass-through, bridge, water click, same bank) and env-terrain's own PE5 recomputation (E-I3)
PE5.accepted_residual: a click on open water (P covered by a water polygon) away from a bridge can only snap to a bridge end node; every other bank node is blocked (exactly one covered) -> END_SNAP_PE5. Conservative and accepted (env-terrain ruling item 4, lead); the product message can say the point is on the water
PE5.known_false_negative: PE5 cannot see anything outside the wide env layer extent (env_layers_wide); no env feature there means no env block
PE5._basis: env-terrain EP2 (far-bank snap); env classes from runway_environment_features.ENV_CLASSES (beach / park / green are walkable and not blocking)

window.OUT_AND_BACK: 100 m before and 100 m after the turnaround along the route

PE6._basis: pre-registered: window reuses the R2 100 m physical rationale (env-terrain EP3); inside the window any hit of the listed rules counts (their route-level minimum lengths do not apply)

pre_registration.frozen_before: the first non-LOOP pool (IMPL1_PLAN P6); none may be derived from P6 or other outcome data
